## Design

### 2026-10-06 — October 6: Beginning of the project

**2.5h**

October 6: Beginning of the project
I began by planning what i would want the circuit to do and how it would do it. I thought that i could use a buzzer and a red LED connected to an arduino uno to simulate the alarm. I started simulating it in tinkercad and began writing the code, right now it works perfectly, the LED and the buzzer start beeping and flashing after 15 minutes but i think it's too big, i think i might change it to an arduino nano so that it can be all atached to the remote without making it a lot bigger.
